axis: RAG data/artifact niches — the kind of DATA or MODELING ARTIFACT. DISTINCT from PROJECT_SCOPE's 6 SCIENTIFIC-DOMAIN niches (N1 systems modeling, N2 tissue biophysics, N3 embryology/genomics, N4 signaling, N5 ocular, N6 tissue engineering). A corpus item is tagged on BOTH axes: which scientific domain it serves AND which data-niche it is.
ratification: KEEP-AS-IS ratified by Emmanuel 2026-06-11 (ADR-0018, governance gp-2026-06-11-niche-taxonomy-q30) after a unanimous composite-audit rejected the ocular->biophysics merge (it would collapse Test 5). Keeping the taxonomy fixed does NOT freeze it: the corpus-classifier MUST always be able to recommend where to change (audit_categorization), human-gated. Metabolic discriminator accepted (metabolic_role in corpus_manifest schema).
revisable_note: Human-gated mutable: recommend changes freely (corpus-classifier audit / governance-proposal), apply only via a human gate. The 2026-06-11 ratification is keep-as-is on the two-axis design; the recommendation path stays open. See docs/findings/2026-06-11-q30-niche-taxonomy-resolution.md + held_out Q30.

niches.name: Transcriptómica y dinámica de linajes
niches.purpose: Lineage hierarchy trees + transition-probability matrices (.json); average expression per cell type (.csv/.tsv: rows=key genes pax2a/foxc1a/tfap2a, cols=hpf or clusters); curated lineage-restriction notes from lineage-tracing literature (.md/.txt).

niches.name: Estructura proteica y complejos
niches.purpose: 3D coords of experimentally resolved structures (RA receptors; TFs tfap2a/foxc1a/pax2a/wt1a; Notch/Jagged2a extracellular domains; collagen-fibronectin complexes; tubular claudins); AlphaFold metadata (.json) for proteins without a zebrafish crystal structure; predicted-aligned-error (.pae/.npy) for complexes (Jagged2a-Notch, Foxc1a-Pitx2); small molecules/drugs for perturbation docking (.mol2/.sdf: RA, DEAB).

niches.name: Redes de señalización y parámetros cinéticos
niches.purpose: Signaling/state-transition trees + simulation env variables (.json); average expression + biophysical constants (.csv/.tsv); lineage-restriction summaries (.md/.txt); systems-biology descriptions / curated object skeletons (.xml/.cellml/.sed-ml); BioNetGen rule-based models (.bngl) packaged by the substrate → equations → Morpheus .xml.

niches.name: Microambiente bioquímico
niches.purpose: Mass-spec metabolomics/lipidomics (.mzML/.mzXML; MCP wrapper → .csv); spatial lipid distribution maps (.imML); 2D/3D O2/pH gradient maps for Morpheus (.json/.yaml); kinetic time-series (ion fluxes, intracellular Ca during tubulogenesis) (.csv/.tsv); local metabolic pathway maps (.xml KEGG/MetaCyc).

niches.name: Bioeléctrica
niches.purpose: Spatial coords + absolute membrane potential (.csv); high-density temporal matrices from fluorescence/voltage sensors (.mat); molecular config (ion channels, surface densities, permeability, activation states) (.json); voltage-imaging video with segmentation masks (.ome/.tiff).

niches.name: Biomecánica pasiva y ECM
niches.purpose: Affinity matrices, basal cortical tension, cell-friction coefficients for Morpheus (.json); regional stiffness profiles (Young's kPa from AFM) (.csv); SHG / super-res IF of collagen-fibronectin (.ome/.tiff); static scaffold/basal-membrane geometry templates (.xml); FEA meshes of static deformation / viscoelastic stress as boundary conditions (.vtk/.vtu).

niches.name: Mecánica activa y dinámica de fluidos
niches.purpose: Cell/segment/node-indexed flow vectors, velocity, pressure (.csv/.tsv); high-density 3D meshes with velocity gradients + stress tensors (.vtu/.vtp); velocimetry/AFM matrices, elastic constants, traction fields (.mat); fluid-env physical properties (.json); CFD mesh/solution interchange (.cgns).

niches.name: Cinética celular colectiva
niches.purpose: Per-region/per-stage statistics (mean migration velocity, apoptosis %/hr) (.json); raw cell trajectories indexed by cell ID + time (.csv/.tsv); ImageJ/Fiji cell-tracking lineage topology (.xml); occupancy / delamination heatmaps (.h5); collective displacement + deformation-velocity tensors (.npz).

niches.name: Morfología emergente y topología
niches.purpose: Raw volumetric confocal time-series + segmentation masks (.ome/.tiff/.czi/.ims/.nd2); continuous voxel arrays from anatomical reconstructions / OCT (.nii/.nii.gz); polygonal meshes (.ply/.stl/.obj); formal birth-death persistence pairs + network-topology vectors (.json); morphometric traits (.csv).

niches.name: Tejidos chaperones y boundary conditions
niches.purpose: Cartesian coords of neighboring tissues + timing matrices (.json); the master indexed interaction table Source → Target → Signal → Temporal window (.csv); experimental-embryology literature (.pdf).

niches.name: Claims curados de literatura biológica
niches.purpose: Bibliographic reference databases (.bib/.ris); scientific documents + curated claims (.pdf/.json/.md).

niches.name: Perturbaciones e intervenciones causales
niches.purpose: Generated docs: perturbation/intervention designs (candidate sets, controls, confounders). Ranked-candidate work routes through causal-pruner + HUMAN GATE.

niches.name: Modelos de simulación y código
niches.purpose: Generated docs: simulation models + code (Morpheus .xml, BioNetGen .bngl, analysis scripts).
